200.description: Cycle count recorded and reconciled (discrepancy indicates whether counted quantity differed from system quantity).

systemQuantity.description: Quantity system records show for this bin prior to reconciliation.

discrepancy.description: True if countedQuantity differed from systemQuantity.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, binId path segment missing/empty, or the body omits countedQuantity (an explicit 0 is a valid empty-bin count; omitting the field is a client mistake).
